reading.format: each square: [center_x, center_y, cos, sin] as exact rationals; (cos, sin) is the unit direction of one edge

claim.limitations: Exact rational coordinates of a packing of 90 unit squares, given as four corners per square. verify_exact.py checks in rational arithmetic that every square lies in the container and that all pairs of squares have disjoint interiors. The file proves an upper bound for the side. It makes no statement on optimality.
